summary_md: The lane couldn't get this past its own validation in 2 rounds — /review didn't clear this to ship: BYOK daily-limit cap in syncPrices() (modules/pricing/jobs.ts) does providerCardRefs = cardRefs.slice(0, budget) with no rotation/offset across runs, so every run caps to the SAME leading slice of the catalog (stable cards-table order). Any card past that cutoff (guaranteed once catalog > smallest provider limit, e.g. pricecharting's 500) permanently never gets a BYOK price, and since graded (PSA/BGS) prices are BYOK-exclusive (pricecharting/poketrace/pokemon-price-tracker), those cards never get graded pricing at all. This reintroduces exactly the 'quietly wrong market-wide data' problem ARCA-063 exists to fix, now scoped to BYOK/graded data instead of held-only data, and is untested (jobs.test.ts only asserts the cap exists, not that coverage rotates).. No PR opened; it needs a human.
